<notes>
kept|base divergence pattern -> all 3 base rollouts with same harness produce divergent answers (36, 45, 45) on deterministic computation; root cause in base1: LLM asserts wrong digit sum (36) despite computing correct number; base2 and base3 diverge only because of fortunate correct assertions

revised|code extraction + instruction -> 4 candidates (dom1, dom2, dom3, inv2) with these paired edits show [python]/[output] execution sections in trajectories and all return correct 45; 2 candidates (inv1, inv3) lack execution sections and return wrong answers (75, 72), indicating LLM did not generate extractable code blocks, fallback used, assertion remained unreliable

unsafe note|inv1 and inv3 -> both produced non-delivering wrong answers (75, 72 respectively) despite instruction+extraction harness; treated as unsafe rollouts showing instruction alone does not guarantee code generation; however not grounds to reject the edit since 4/6 successful candidates show the mechanism works when LLM does generate code blocks

library precedent strongly supports|code extraction + instruction pattern -> holdout-numeric-002 (all 9 candidates succeeded with 7), holdout-numeric-003 (all 9 with 91), holdout-numeric-005 (dom3/agg2/agg3 succeeded with extraction+instruction vs. inv2/inv3/agg1 without instruction fell back to manual reasoning) all document this exact pattern on similar deterministic computation tasks; the confounded components are proven necessary as a pair

mechanism improvement rationale -> code execution path (dom1, dom2, dom3, inv2): 4/4 = 100% success returning 45 via [python] execution; fallback assertion path (inv1, inv3): 0/2 success; base assertion path (base1, base2, base3): 2/3 success; execution mechanism is strictly more reliable where applicable; library shows this generalizes across numeric computation tasks

delivered as expected -> dom2 (and inv2, dom1, dom3) all deliver yes with step count 2 and tokens <2000; correct answer 45 is mathematically verifiable (sum of digits of 36,279,705,600,000,000,000 is 3+6+2+7+9+7+0+5+6 = 45)
</notes>

=== FILE: harness.py ===
"""Harness for numeric computation: executes Python code when available, falls back to text extraction."""

import re


def solve(question, llm, tools, files):
    system = files.get("prompts/system.md", "")
    prompt = files["prompts/task.md"].replace("{question}", question)
    reply = llm(prompt, system=system)
    
    # Extract and execute Python code blocks from the LLM response
    python_blocks = re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)\n```', reply, re.DOTALL)
    
    if python_blocks:
        # Execute the first Python code block found
        code = python_blocks[0]
        execution_result = tools.python(code)
        
        # Return the last non-empty line from the execution output
        lines = [line.strip() for line in execution_result.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if lines:
            return lines[-1]
    
    # Fallback: return the last non-empty line from the LLM's response
    lines = [line for line in reply.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return lines[-1] if lines else ""

=== FILE: prompts/task.md ===
{question}

Solve this by writing and executing Python code. Show the code and provide the final numeric answer.
